title: Knocked up Roasty Mediterranean Apple Roast
description: A malty and pillowy Mediterranean dish featuring apples and roast, perfect for a lazy Sunday dinner. This halal-friendly recipe is served on a lazy-susan-spinner, making it easy to share with family and friends.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Transfer the lamb to a large Dutch oven and roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Add the sliced apples to the Dutch oven and continue to roast for an additional 20 minutes.
Brush the malt syrup over the lamb and apples during the last 10 minutes of roasting.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the roast on a lazy-susan-spinner, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
